why: SG-04 Covers (line 1732) says an unanswered cancel can take effect late, after a lookup has shown the order open, but the second-CO-A2 timeout row (line 102) and CO-S26 treat that same kind of lookup as final: the agent tells the customer 'not cancelled' and makes no CO-A4. The two parts of the spec disagree, and no input (round 3 Q4 covers only the first timeout) supports treating the lookup as final.
